sourceTitle: Science and Culture, and Other Essays
description: "Science and Culture, and Other Essays" by Thomas Henry Huxley is a collection of essays written in the late 19th century. This work compiles addresses, lectures, and essays exploring the intersection of science and education, arguing for the importance of scientific training as a foundation for true intellectual culture.
